from __future__ import annotations

import re

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import (
    NormalizedMessage,
    normalize_content,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_MULTIMODAL_CONTENT_NORMALIZATION[revision==2]")
def test_image_height_boundary_at_max_dimension() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError, match=r"too large \(max \d+x(\d+)\)"
    ) as exc_info:
        normalize_content([Image.new("RGB", (32, 65536))])

    match = re.search(r"\(max \d+x(\d+)\)", str(exc_info.value))
    assert match is not None
    max_dimension = int(match.group(1))

    normalized = normalize_content([Image.new("RGB", (32, max_dimension))])
    assert isinstance(normalized, NormalizedMessage)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"too large"):
        normalize_content([Image.new("RGB", (32, max_dimension + 1))])
